claim_text: The corpus contains 2,424,793 canonical daily PM2.5 observations and 1,689 monitor time series.
notes: Counts are source-snapshot specific.

claim_text: The complete event universe contains 563 persistent 88101 Method Code transition anchors.
notes: A Method Code transition remains a metadata anchor.

claim_text: 238 anchors have at least three distinct physical geographic donors.
filters: one best POC per physical donor site
notes: Physical donor uniqueness is enforced.

claim_text: The audit has 228 complete comparisons, 325 donor-insufficient events, and 10 estimator-input failures.
notes: Counts reconcile to 563.

claim_text: The stable synthetic benchmark has 146 physical target sites: 66 calibration and 80 evaluation sites with disjoint complete target-plus-donor footprints.
notes: The 80 evaluation targets have already been viewed and cannot be reused for tuning.

claim_text: Each local and matched regional perturbation variant has 400 evaluation samples.
notes: Five local shapes plus five matched regional variants.

claim_text: Standard synthetic control aggregate local-effect MAE/AUPRC/macro-F1/regional FPR are 0.09983/0.91476/0.81641/0.140.
calculation: Read and round with project half-up display rule.
notes: Benchmark-specific, not universal performance.

claim_text: Fixed-prior and cross-validated MetaShift aggregate MAE/AUPRC/macro-F1/regional FPR are reported against standard synthetic control.
filters: method in metashift_v1_fixed, metashift_v2_cv; aggregate rows
calculation: Read and round with project half-up display rule.
notes: No composite favorable score is used.

claim_text: Cross-validated MetaShift has a -0.00240 paired MAE difference versus standard synthetic control, 95% CI [-0.00772, 0.00347].
calculation: Read and half-up round to five decimals.
notes: The confidence interval crosses zero.

claim_text: Fixed-prior MetaShift has a 0.00361 paired MAE difference versus standard synthetic control, 95% CI [-0.00401, 0.01163].
calculation: Read and half-up round to five decimals.
notes: The confidence interval crosses zero.

claim_text: Main and ablation experiments share 7,300 exactly aligned standard-synthetic-control rows to tolerance 1e-10.
notes: Guards against random-seed confounding in ablations.

claim_text: The real audit assigns 34 supported candidates, 122 not-supported events, and 407 inconclusive events.
notes: Evidence tiers are not causal or fault labels.

claim_text: 157 complete events have at least 50 stable post-transition time placebos; 128 have 100.
notes: 71 anchors lack enough stable placebo dates.

claim_text: 71 complete events have raw time-placebo probability at most 0.10, while 40 pass the exploratory BH q<=0.10 screen.
notes: Screening quantities are exploratory, not causal p-values.

claim_text: The date-resampling comparison uses 200 resamples and has upper-tail probability 0.00498.
notes: Supports diagnostic difference from stable dates, not physical causation.

claim_text: The donor-as-treated placebo table has 866 records and median standardized score 0.40831.
notes: Corrects the earlier draft's stale record count.

claim_text: Fixed-weight intervals exclude zero for 159/228 MetaShift, 145/228 standard synthetic control, and 134/228 nearest-neighbor DiD events.
notes: These are conditional diagnostic intervals.

claim_text: Selection-aware nested intervals are available for 227 events; 153 exclude zero and mean width is 0.19057 log units.
calculation: Count excludes; mean upper minus lower.
notes: One event fails nested resampling; scope remains fixed candidate pool.

claim_text: Leave-one-donor-out refits are complete for 227 events, and 202 retain direction under every donor removal.
notes: One partial result is retained rather than removed.

claim_text: Nominal 95% fixed-weight conditional bootstrap coverage on evaluation is 63.9% to 67.3% across four methods.
notes: Undercoverage is a negative calibration result.

claim_text: Nominal 90% split-conformal coverage on evaluation is 98.8% to 99.6% across four methods.
notes: Overcoverage is a negative calibration result.

claim_text: Selection-aware synthetic coverage is not reported because the frozen full donor-reselection protocol was infeasible within the deadline.
notes: Real nested intervals are not claimed to have calibrated coverage.

claim_text: Nine of eleven hourly same-site POC candidates have paired hourly windows, with eight of nine daily/hourly direction agreements.
calculation: Count paired rows and true agreement.
notes: Same-site POC is not physical-instrument ground truth.

claim_text: The targeted external-document review found 0/20 dated site-specific confirmations.
calculation: Read summary fields and reconcile with CSV.
notes: An unlocated notice is unavailable evidence, not evidence of no change.

claim_text: The independent 88502 pipeline has 34 anchors and 3 complete common-method comparisons.
calculation: Read anchor count and count complete rows.
notes: Do not combine 88502 and 88101.

claim_text: The v0.3.2 evidence release passes 35 release-gate checks, 12 document-consistency checks, 57 manuscript-number checks, and 59 unit tests; two designated hash captures match.
notes: Release gate and reports are generated outputs, not scientific outcomes.
